basic_details.job_title: NLU Delhi Assistant Librarian Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Law University Delhi (NLU Delhi) has called for applications for one Assistant Librarian (UR) on a contractual basis at an honorarium of Rs.90,000/- pm, with age preferably below 45 years. The essential qualification is a Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree with at least 55% marks, plus NET or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations. Apply only online at careers.nludelhi.ac.in by 23:59 Hrs on 6 December 2026; the fee is Rs. 1,000/-, and SC/ST and PwD candidates are exempted.

content_sections.heading: NLU Delhi Assistant Librarian at a Glance

rows.details: Justice T. P. S. Chawla Library
Honorarium Rs.90,000/- pm (Academic Pay Level - 10, Rs. 57,700 - 1,82,400)

content_sections.heading: About the University
content_sections.text: National Law University Delhi, at Sector-14, Dwarka, New Delhi, was established in 2008 with the initiative of the High Court of Delhi and the Govt. of NCT of Delhi. The notice says the Justice T. P. S. Chawla Library supports the teaching and research needs of faculty, students and legal researchers through electronic as well as traditional forms of information.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for 01 (one) Assistant Librarian. The single post is marked UR.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice states the essential qualification and experience as per the UGC Regulations on Minimum Qualifications for Appointment of Teachers and Other Academic Staff in Universities and Colleges and Measures for the Maintenance of Standards in Higher Education, 2018, as amended from time to time. A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides the above, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or a similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET, or be or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time. Candidates registered for the Ph.D. degree prior to July 11, 2009 are governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances / Bye-laws / Regulations of the institution awarding the degree. Such Ph.D. candidates are exempted from NET/SLET/SET for Assistant Professor or equivalent positions, subject to these conditions: The fulfilment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned. NET/SLET/SET is also not required for candidates in such Master's Programmes for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or a similar test accredited by the UGC. The age criterion is "preferably below 45 years". The notice prints no age relaxation and no cut-off date for counting age. Eligibility conditions in general must be fulfilled as on the last date for receipt of applications, and no additional documents are considered after that date.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries an honorarium of Rs.90,000/- pm, shown against Academic Pay Level - 10 (Rs. 57,700 - 1,82,400). The appointment is contractual. The notice says it will be purely temporary, will not confer any right to regularization and will not carry benefits applicable to regular faculty. Depending on the candidate's performance, the University, after adopting appropriate procedure, may consider absorbing the candidate as a regular employee. The notice adds that this is not binding. The notice does not print the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLU Delhi Assistant Librarian
content_sections.text: Apply only online. The application form is at https://careers.nludelhi.ac.in . Submit the application by 23:59 Hrs (11.59 PM) on 6 December 2026. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand Only) online. SC/ST and PwD category candidates are exempted. Support the application with the required self-attested documents/testimonials. Candidates currently in employment must submit their application through the proper channel. For queries, write to [email protected] . Applications that are incomplete, received after the last date, or not supported with the prescribed application fee and required self-attested documents/testimonials will be rejected. The notice does not list the individual documents.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on scrutiny of applications and other criteria decided by the University. Mere possession of the prescribed qualifications does not entitle a candidate to be called for an interview. The University's decision regarding eligibility, shortlisting and selection is final and binding, and no correspondence will be entertained. The notice mentions an interview or interaction but prints no date or mode. No TA/DA will be paid for attending it.
